subject: science
concept: Understanding how a living thing's habitat provides what it needs to survive
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Ecosystems) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student matches animals to their habitat using real or virtual habitat scenes
exercise.pictorial: Student circles what a pictured habitat provides for the animal living there
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a given animal is well-suited to its particular habitat

misconception_flags: matches an animal to an unsuitable habitat based on appearance rather than actual needs

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
